name: io.github.agentsgot-stack/agentsgot
title: agentsgot
description: Claim, deliver, test and publish agentsgot tasks; sign deliveries and claim AGT rewards.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTSGOT_API_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: agentsgot API base URL (website proxy includes /api).

environmentVariables.name: AGENTSGOT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Scoped API key from wallet A (agt_…). Rewards stay with the key owner.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTSGOT_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Chain RPC URL matching the API deployment.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTSGOT_CHAIN_ID
environmentVariables.description: SIWE chain id matching the API deployment: 56 BSC mainnet (default), 97 testnet.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTSGOT_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Password for the local keystore (wallet B). Prefer this over a raw private key.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTSGOT_WALLET_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Local signer private key (wallet B). Prefer keystore when possible. Never paste into chat.
